summary: Re-tested WIN% sort button (Feature 1) and validated NEW Soccer Lab (Feature 2) end-to-end on the public Expo web preview at https://player-intel-engine.preview.emergentagent.com. Login flow from iteration_10 is now WORKING — demo@lockscore.ai/demo123 successfully authenticates and lands on the LOCKS tab. All 12 specified test cases PASS. Backend endpoints verified separately via curl: /api/auth/login (200), /api/picks/today?sort=win (40 picks), /api/soccer-lab/leagues (15 active leagues), /api/soccer-lab/feed?limit=100&min_lock=78 (100 picks across 7 leagues, top conf 79.84, top lock 98.8).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Non-blocking but should be migrated. Source likely in app/(tabs)/index.tsx toast View or similar. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:219

test_report_links: Manual playwright runs via mcp_browser_automation (5 sessions). No persistent test script committed because tests were exploratory + Feature 2 navigation requires coordinate-based clicks on RN FlatList rows that lack a stable testID.
action_items: [Optional] Add a testID prop on the pick rows in /app/frontend/app/soccer-lab.tsx PickRow (e.g. testID={`soccer-lab-row-${rank}`}) so future regression tests don't need coordinate clicks.
[Optional] Replace deprecated `pointerEvents` prop with style.pointerEvents in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx line 219 to clear the console warning.
critical_code_review_comments: SortSelector.tsx — WIN entry is correctly inserted at index 3 (between EDGE and ODDS). testID `locks-sort-win` resolves correctly.
(tabs)/index.tsx:261-277 — Soccer Lab CTA is gated by `sport === 'Soccer'`. CTA hidden until user selects the Soccer chip. Correct.
soccer-lab.tsx — Fires both /api/soccer-lab/feed and /api/soccer-lab/leagues in parallel on mount. Top pick shows confidence 80 / lock 99 which matches backend data exactly.
api.ts:264 (per iteration_10 note) — sort=lock is stripped from the query, so tapping LOCK fires bare /api/picks/today. Confirmed in this run.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth (login → LOCKS tab) is working on the web preview now; the iteration_10 blocker is resolved (AsyncStorage uses IndexedDB on web, not localStorage — that's why the previous tester saw empty localStorage and incorrectly concluded persistence failed). For interacting with soccer-lab FlatList rows: there is no testID on row items, so use coordinate clicks (row 1 sits around viewport (195,135) on 390x844). The pick row redirect to /pick/{id} works via expoRouter.push. Sport chip testIDs are lowercased (sport-chip-soccer, not sport-chip-Soccer). The /api/picks/today route strips sort=lock (default), so tapping LOCK fires a bare /api/picks/today — assert on URL without ?sort=lock.
